free_tier.stated: 3 GB free, permanent (not a trial), zero-knowledge encrypted.

retention.stated: 3 GB free, permanent (not a trial), zero-knowledge encrypted

egress.terms: Free within plan; 10 encrypted links per month on the free tier.

tooling: official clients, Gmail/Outlook plugins; no rclone backend
chaining: 3 GB x unlimited accounts, but 500 MB per-file cap and 2 devices make bulk ingest painful; the encryption is client-side, so a custom client would have to reimplement Tresorit's crypto. Not viable.
limits_note: per-object-cap 500 MB per file; 3 GB total; pull-count 10 encrypted links/month; 2 devices; zero-knowledge means no server-side API for bulk movement.
reliability_note: Data is E2E encrypted with keys Tresorit does not hold. Losing credentials loses data; free tier has no recovery path beyond the local copy.
